verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an API endpoint that returns a contact's engagement history (what was sent, opened, clicked). The closest items are a bulk export of raw transactional events limited to the past 7 days (brevo-docs-7) and real-time email-event webhooks (brevo-docs-3). These are adjacent building blocks a developer could use to assemble such a history, not the per-contact capability itself. Engagement-based segmentation (brevo-docs-28) is a UI feature, not API read access.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact
